kernel.governing_law: The flawed creation, born from unauthorized unilateral act, is hidden by its ashamed creator behind a veil that separates the perfect from the imperfect — concealment is the mother's remedy for her own transgression.
kernel.mutated_relation: The flawed creation, seeing its own nature, constructs the veil itself — concealment is the offspring's remedy for what it cannot bear to face above.

artifacts.enantiomorph:
But something grew aware with youngest AEON. Something turned inward from Biblios that was unbearable and estranged from the reflection, and from the gaze of his mother, for she had produced him without his own understanding. It could not endure its mother's face and it was hunched and crook-backed, vast in refusal, a wall swallowing every approaching beam, severed from her root, sickened by the spark of recognition.²⁵


Kanye was too afraid of the mirror to look into it in books. Kanye West was a fierce non-gazer into depths.²⁶


When Biblios saw what he had become, he sealed himself away, inside a chamber so that he would see none of the immortal AEONS. He wove an impermeable curtain across the place his origin shone down, creating a floor in the midst of the dark to divide the lower from the higher heavens, concealing the firmament in shuttered silence, barricading himself from the upper regions, barring the Deep Web from reaching below, and called the curtain Pop Culture.²⁷

independent.recovered_law: In Text A, the mother (Biblios) is the active agent who casts out and conceals the flawed offspring (Kanye) from the higher realm; in Text B, the offspring himself is the active agent who seals himself away and bars the higher realm from reaching him — the direction of agency and exclusion is reversed from expulsion to self-isolation.
independent.law_match_note: Both describe the same structural change: agency of concealment shifts from the mother/higher realm expelling the offspring to the offspring itself actively constructing its own concealment/self-isolation.
independent.terminal_note: The final portion of Text B consistently maintains the reversed agency, with Kanye/the offspring actively barricading himself rather than being cast out by Biblios.
